nodes.label: ReauthPromptController Pattern for Different-User Resolution
nodes.rationale: Uses a ChangeNotifier controller + MaterialApp.router builder host instead of GlobalKey<NavigatorState> to avoid global mutable navigation state and enable prompt to survive screen changes during different-user sign-in detection

nodes.label: Non-Destructive Boundary Preserved for Different-User Wipe
nodes.rationale: Only explicit confirmation, explicit sign-out, and authoritative verified-empty membership revocation delete local data; unknown session loss stays non-destructive to protect offline authenticity
nodes.norm_label: non-destructive boundary preserved for different-user wipe

nodes.label: Planning Mutation Store Budget with Refusal Gate
nodes.rationale: Measure footprint before write, refuse new mutations when budget exhausted, never undo or delete pending intent; budget guards only record* methods, never status updates that unlock recovery (clearMutation)
nodes.norm_label: planning mutation store budget with refusal gate

nodes.label: Reactive Storage-Layer Failure Eviction Only
nodes.rationale: Measurement classification has no hard consequence; only actual storage write failure triggers eviction once + retry once; proactive measurement-driven eviction runs after successful write to keep storage bounded going forward, never before

nodes.label: Local Revision Column for Sync Snapshot Identity
nodes.rationale: Monotonic per-row counter incremented on every local write (never leaves device) gates post-sync status+clear writes via WHERE clause to prevent concurrent edits from being silently deleted when fold lands during remote round trip
nodes.norm_label: local revision column for sync snapshot identity

nodes.label: Durable Sending Marker for In-Flight Create Cancellation
nodes.rationale: Write durable sending marker before remote call (mirror of accepted marker after) so deletes during create's in-flight window create cancelling tombstone instead of collapsing row, preserving delete intent until create outcome known
nodes.norm_label: durable sending marker for in-flight create cancellation

nodes.label: Vanished Mutation Record During Sync Is Not An Error (D4)
nodes.rationale: Collapsed record from concurrent delete is ordinary outcome not programming defect; return null/false instead of throwing StateError so remaining queued mutations still sync instead of entire pass failing
nodes.norm_label: vanished mutation record during sync is not an error (d4)

nodes.label: Unified Sync Overview View Model
nodes.rationale: Aggregates song catalog, song mutation, planning sync, and planning mutation state into single snapshot for unified sync header control showing synced/unsynced/conflict aggregate status plus reason codes

nodes.label: LocalStorageWriteRecovery Boundary
nodes.rationale: Single shared boundary for every growing local write; on storage-exhaustion-signal exception evicts droppable catalog sources once and retries; protects active context from reactive eviction; non-exhaustion signals surface immediately with best-effort audit record

nodes.label: Song Catalog Eviction With Protected Active Context
nodes.rationale: Reactive evictDroppable excludes active (userId, organizationId) pair entirely from eviction to prevent destroying just-synced catalog while retrying failed write of same context; proactive evictToBudget touches active pair last only if necessary
nodes.norm_label: song catalog eviction with protected active context

nodes.label: Four Purge Reasons Enumeration
nodes.rationale: ADR-035 D1 establishes the central contract: local user data may be destroyed ONLY for userSignOut, accountDeleted, differentUserSignIn, or membershipRevokedConfirmed. Nothing else. This is the structural enforcement that makes ADR-020's policy actual rather than aspirational.

nodes.label: signedOut Requires Explicit Act
nodes.rationale: D2 removes the guard that mapped every null-session event to destructive signedOut. A null session now maps to signedOut only when app itself initiated sign-out or no LastKnownIdentity exists. Every other case (cold start, sessionExpired) maps to sessionExpired instead, preserving data.

nodes.label: Reads From Local Database, Not Live Session
nodes.rationale: D3 gives SongCatalogController and PlanningSyncController an offline-authenticated read path that establishes context from LastKnownIdentity when a matching local snapshot exists, with no network call or live session check. Makes read access independent of session validity.
nodes.norm_label: reads from local database, not live session

nodes.label: Conditional, Organization-Scoped Snapshot Replacement
nodes.rationale: D4 (Phase 3): an empty incoming snapshot must not replace a non-empty stored one without a second independent empty confirmation. Snapshot replace adopts explicit blue/green write shape. Narrowing from (userId) to (userId, organizationId) scope.

nodes.label: verifiedEmpty Quarantines Before Purge - Two-Confirmation Gate
nodes.rationale: D5 (Phase 4): first empty-membership resolution records membershipRevokedAt and quarantines read-only. Purge needs second fresh, online, authenticated empty resolution plus no pending work or user confirmation. This is the core membership-revocation quarantine mechanism that protects against flaky empty signals.
nodes.norm_label: verifiedempty quarantines before purge - two-confirmation gate

nodes.label: Eviction Triggered by Storage Pressure, Proportionate to Pressure
nodes.rationale: D6 (Phase 3): eviction fires only on concrete storage-exhaustion signal or measured footprint over budget. Evicts least-recently-read first. Marks affected snapshot recoverable on next online refresh. Amends ADR-028's eviction trigger and proportionality.
nodes.norm_label: eviction triggered by storage pressure, proportionate to pressure

nodes.label: One Gate, One Audit Trail - LocalDataLifecycle
nodes.rationale: D7 (Phase 2, implemented): LocalDataLifecycle is the sole caller of all purge primitives (deleteCatalogs, deletePlanning, clearIdentity, writeIdentity). Exposes four gated methods requiring PurgeReason. In-memory identity cache sync is a single indivisible operation inside the gate, not two separate call sites that can drift.
nodes.norm_label: one gate, one audit trail - localdatalifecycle

nodes.label: Android Backup Set to allowBackup=false
nodes.rationale: D8 (Phase 4): AndroidManifest.xml application tag set allowBackup=false instead of authoring data-extraction rules. Makes half-restored device state structurally impossible rather than by rule maintenance.

nodes.label: Phase 4: One Shared Gate with Identity Row Marker
nodes.rationale: New nullable membershipRevokedAt DateTimeColumn on LastKnownIdentityRows. Both auth_providers.dart and planning_providers.dart call one new LocalDataLifecycle.resolveVerifiedEmptyMembership() gate (not purging directly). Makes two consecutive confirmations one definition across both call sites.
nodes.norm_label: phase 4: one shared gate with identity row marker

nodes.label: Phase 4: MembershipQuarantinedException Write-Blocking Guard
nodes.rationale: Guard at six mutation-service entry points checks LastKnownIdentityStore.read().membershipRevokedAt before any mutationStore call. If non-null, throws MembershipQuarantinedException. Quarantine withdraws edit access for specific userId; reads unaffected (read-only quarantine, not read-blocked).

nodes.label: Phase 4: Banner and Dialog Coexistence with ADR-029
nodes.rationale: MembershipQuarantineBanner follows identical declarative shape as ReauthBanner, watching membershipRevokedAt. Confirmation dialog (second confirmation, pending work present) reuses ADR-029's ReauthPromptHost via new MembershipQuarantinePurgePrompt sealed variant.
nodes.norm_label: phase 4: banner and dialog coexistence with adr-029

nodes.label: Residual Risk: clearIdentity's userId:null Path Outside Mutation Chain
nodes.rationale: INFERRED: clearIdentity's userId:null call shape (ordinary explicit sign-out) has no key to schedule against and stays unserialized. Safety depends on out-of-file invariant (SongCatalogController bump + staleness checkpoint). Lower stakes than membership-revocation races but deserves tracking for future changes.
nodes.norm_label: residual risk: clearidentity's userid:null path outside mutation chain

nodes.label: Phase 3: pendingEmptyConfirmationAt Marker on Snapshot Row
nodes.rationale: New nullable pendingEmptyConfirmationAt on CachedCatalogSnapshots persists the 'one empty resolution already seen' fact. Persisted (not in-memory) so a genuine multi-cold-start catalog empty can accumulate confirmations. Cleared on second confirmation or any accepted non-empty replace.
nodes.norm_label: phase 3: pendingemptyconfirmationat marker on snapshot row

nodes.label: Phase 3: Eviction Ordering Is Cost-Free Proxy, Not True LRU
nodes.rationale: SongCatalogEvictor.evictDroppable() orders by non-active (userId,organizationId) first, then oldest refreshedAt/snapshotVersion, never touching active last. Uses only existing columns, adds no per-read cost. Approximates LRU intent without true tracking.
nodes.norm_label: phase 3: eviction ordering is cost-free proxy, not true lru

nodes.label: ADR-031: Catalog Refresh Coalescing Scoped to Session Identity
nodes.rationale: Coalescing is scoped to session identity (AppAuthSession.userId), never to mere presence. Matching identity reuses in-flight future. Differing identity queues one follow-up behind in-flight. Fixes web-only startup race where refresh fired with null session before auth listener's signedIn event landed.
nodes.norm_label: adr-031: catalog refresh coalescing scoped to session identity

nodes.label: ADR-032: Provider Failures Are Terminal, Retry Is User Action
nodes.rationale: noAutomaticProviderRetry returns null for every attempt on every FutureProvider/StreamProvider. Declared on providers, not container, so test overrides do not silence the policy. Guard test parses every library in lib/ to fail when a provider omits the policy.
nodes.norm_label: adr-032: provider failures are terminal, retry is user action

nodes.label: ADR-033: Reader Design Token Layer
nodes.rationale: ReaderTheme extension carries lyricStyle, chordStyle, chordChipColor, sectionLabelStyle, commentStyle, directiveStyle, tabStyle. Both stageLight and stageDark factories wired into MaterialApp.router. Every reader content widget and estimator read via ReaderTheme.of(context) instead of deriving styles. Closes UX-7 (no dark theme).

nodes.label: ADR-033 Amendment (2026-08-12): Row Heights and Gaps Now Breakpoint-Resolved
nodes.rationale: SongReaderMetrics carries every row height and gap, threaded through song_reader_fit.dart as defaulted parameter. ReaderThemeSet holds compact and regular ReaderTheme. ReaderTheme.of(context) resolves from viewport width. Reader widgets and estimator go through same shared resolution point so cannot see different row heights.
nodes.norm_label: adr-033 amendment (2026-08-12): row heights and gaps now breakpoint-resolved

nodes.label: ADR-034: Reader Chrome Model - Compact Shell
nodes.rationale: Bottom bar always visible (64px tablet / 58px phone). Top bar and control rail hidden by default, revealed by tapping content, float over it. Both floating surfaces excluded from fit calculation's available height via non-positioned Stack children. Recovers 195px chrome to flat 64px.
nodes.norm_label: adr-034: reader chrome model - compact shell

nodes.label: ADR-034: Chrome Metrics and Safe Area Inset Consumption
nodes.rationale: Each surface consumes the safe-area inset it sits against, replacing blanket SafeArea wrapper. Bottom bar reads viewPaddingOf().bottom and grows downwards. Top bar takes top inset. Rail offset adds right inset. Scrolling content adds top/side insets but NOT bottom (bar is below, not floating over).
nodes.norm_label: adr-034: chrome metrics and safe area inset consumption

nodes.label: ADR-016: Connectivity-Gated Cached Membership Fallback
nodes.rationale: EXTRACTED: ADR-031 cites ADR-016 for its role in pre-existing fallback when refresh fails offline. Referenced as a prerequisite pattern but not detailed in ADR-031.

nodes.label: ADR-020: Non-Destructive Session and Offline-Authenticated State
nodes.rationale: ADR-020 set the policy: local data destroyed ONLY on explicit sign-out or authoritative membership revocation, never on connectivity-driven or unknown session loss. ADR-035 enforces this policy structurally. D2 and D3 make offline-authenticated access actually reachable.
nodes.norm_label: adr-020: non-destructive session and offline-authenticated state

nodes.label: ADR-028: Local Storage Budget and Eviction Policy
nodes.rationale: ADR-035 D6 amends ADR-028's eviction trigger and proportionality. ADR-028 appears to define budget mechanism; D6 narrows trigger condition.
nodes.norm_label: adr-028: local storage budget and eviction policy

nodes.label: ADR-029: Reauth Prompt Host Pattern
nodes.rationale: ADR-029 built ReauthPromptController/ReauthPromptHost for must-survive-navigation dialogs. ADR-035 Phase 4 reuses this pattern for MembershipQuarantinePurgePrompt via sealed ReauthPrompt variant.

nodes.label: LF-T2: Refresh-Token TTL Is Real Offline Ceiling for Sync
nodes.rationale: LF-T2 initially conflated sync and data durability. Corrected: refresh-token TTL bounds SYNC only, never local data. D2/D3 of ADR-035 make local reads independent of TTL. User stays offline-authenticated; sync pauses until interactive re-auth on reconnect.
nodes.norm_label: lf-t2: refresh-token ttl is real offline ceiling for sync

nodes.label: LF-T5: OCC Divergence Grows With Offline Duration
nodes.rationale: LF-T5 notes pending mutations carry base_version; longer offline means staler base versions at reconnect. Phase 4 does not reduce divergence but makes it observable and bounded: S12 mutation budget caps pending intent; footprint monitor surfaces pending count and storage pressure.
nodes.norm_label: lf-t5: occ divergence grows with offline duration

nodes.label: LF-T6: Server-Clock Anchor for Reconcile Ordering
nodes.rationale: LF-T6: device clock skew over long offline spans can distort ordering/freshness. Real fix needs server-clock anchor (new subsystem). This slice added injectable now seam to PlanningMutationReconciler so future work can attach to it. Probe characterizes gap remains.
nodes.norm_label: lf-t6: server-clock anchor for reconcile ordering

nodes.label: Web/IndexedDB Offline E2E Coverage Gap
nodes.rationale: Native relaunch suite covers offline logic; web/IndexedDB behavior entirely unverified. Tab-close, service-worker, quota-eviction interactions with auth token unobserved. Deferred awaiting chromedriver CI lane. Web build job now in place but proves compile only.

nodes.label: Reader Fit Estimator: Deliberate Upper Bound Over Rendered Height
nodes.rationale: Fit estimator picks largest font scale whose estimated height fits available, so under-estimate lets fit-to-screen overflow. Tests assert estimated >= rendered one-sidedly. Cost is smaller auto-fit fonts. Type-scale numbers show ratios tightened to 1.01 on whole-song fixtures.
